project_context.archetype: Archetype 3: Pastel & Soft (Light) / Archetype 5: Jewel & Luxury (Dark)

typography.font_install: Add fonts from Google Fonts in index.css or via next/font. For raw React, import in index.css.

light_mode.background_strategy: Fixed background image using the light background image URL provided.
light_mode.glass_surface: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]

dark_mode.background_strategy: Fixed background image using the dark background image URL provided.
dark_mode.glass_surface: bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.3)]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use padding like p-6, p-8 to allow the glassmorphism to breathe. Do not crowd elements.
spacing_and_layout.container: h-screen w-full flex overflow-hidden p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 gap-6 relative z-10
spacing_and_layout.sidebar: w-full md:w-80 lg:w-96 flex flex-col gap-4 h-full flex-shrink-0 glass_surface rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6
spacing_and_layout.main_chat: flex-1 hidden md:flex flex-col h-full min-w-0 glass_surface rounded-3xl overflow-hidden

motion_and_interactions.message_entrance: animate-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 fade-in duration-300 ease-out fill-mode-both

chat_list.item_style: flex flex-row items-center gap-4 rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-4 cursor-pointer relative group transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5
chat_list.avatar_container: w-12 h-12 rounded-full overflow-hidden border-2 border-white/30 flex-shrink-0
chat_list.unread_badge: bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-full text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 ml-auto

chat_window.header: Sticky top-0 z-10 p-4 sm:p-6 border-b border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 bg-white/40 dark:bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-between
chat_window.message_list: flex-1 flex flex-col gap-4 p-4 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto
chat_window.message_bubble_user: bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm p-4 max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[70%] self-end shadow-sm
chat_window.message_bubble_receiver: bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-800/80 backdrop-blur-md text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm p-4 max-w-[85%] sm:max-w-[70%] self-start shadow-[0_4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]
chat_window.input_area: p-4 border-t border-black/5 dark:border-white/5 bg-white/30 dark:bg-black/30 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4
chat_window.input_field: flex-1 bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/50 border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 rounded-full px-6 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500/50 transition-all text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-50 placeholder:text-slate-500

contacts_new_chat.strategy: Use Shadcn Tabs in the sidebar header to switch between 'Chats' and 'Contacts'. Contacts list uses the same item_style as chat_list but includes an alphabet divider (A, B, C...) which is sticky.
contacts_new_chat.fab: Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom-right of sidebar for 'New Chat' using primary color, shadow-lg, and + icon.

profile_settings.strategy: Shadcn Dialog for Profile/Settings accessible from sidebar header avatar click. Dialog must have glass_surface styling (override default DialogContent bg).
profile_settings.content: Large avatar (w-24 h-24) centered, with an elegant name/status typography block. Settings options in a glassmorphic list below.

theme_toggle.strategy: Placed in the sidebar header or settings dialog. Use Shadcn Switch or an icon button swapping between Phosphor Sun/Moon icons.

emoji_picker_ui.strategy: Shadcn Popover anchored to a smiley icon inside the input area. Custom popover content: tight grid of emojis, no background on emojis until hover.

file_attachment_ui.strategy: Shadcn DropdownMenu anchored to a Paperclip icon in the input area.
file_attachment_ui.menu_items: Document, Image, Video, Audio using Phosphor icons.
file_attachment_ui.upload_preview: A small horizontal scrolling area above the input box that renders image thumbnails (w-16 h-16 rounded-lg border border-white/20) with a top-right 'x' button to remove.

icons.instructions: Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react. Use Duotone weight for a sophisticated, layered look matching the glassmorphism.

images.description: Abstract pastel gradient background. Use as fixed 100vh 100vw absolute background for the light mode app.
Vivid dark neon background. Use as fixed 100vh 100vw absolute background for the dark mode app.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text inside glass surfaces has enough contrast. In dark mode, ensure text is bright white over dark glass.
